title: AI融资循环：链条若断裂，营收预期会受多大冲击？
speaker: Anne Letty & Kevin Gordon

segments.en: Now you guys are thinking about how that can ultimately impact not only markets from a macro perspective, but some of these smaller companies in the private space and even those that are public that have partnerships with NVIDIA.
segments.zh: 你们如何考虑这对市场以及那些与英伟达合作的私营和上市公司的影响？

segments.en: I think it's interesting because we are at this unique time where we are seeing differentiation in financing. It is bringing more flexibility.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，我们正处于融资分化的独特时期，这带来了更多灵活性。

segments.en: I talked about earlier the corporate borrowing rate has kind of increased pretty, pretty steeply since the beginning of the year.
segments.zh: 年初以来企业借贷成本上升较快。

segments.en: Again, if you look at historic measures, it doesn't really stand out that much, but how quickly it's gone up does matter for companies.
segments.zh: 从历史看不算突出，但上升速度对企业很重要。

segments.en: So I do think having availability of other types of financing can work. Now, you know, I'm a little hesitant to just to the thought that we don't know exactly when things really do slow down how all of the circular, circular financing will turn out.
segments.zh: 其他融资渠道可能有用，但我对循环融资在放缓时的表现有些保留。

segments.en: So I do have a little bit of reservation between what it looks like today and how helpful it can be for the economy today.
segments.zh: 我对当前状况及其对经济的帮助程度有所保留。

segments.en: But maybe the unknown unknowns that we will find out about later.
segments.zh: 但未来可能会有未知的风险。

segments.en: So I'm not an individual company analyst, but I think from a macro level, you do have to pay attention to the risks of some of the circular financing.
segments.zh: 我不是个股分析师，但从宏观层面，需要关注循环融资的风险。

segments.en: I mean, if some of the links start to break down, that probably takes down some of the estimates for revenue that has implications for the companies buying from each other and so on and so forth.
segments.zh: 如果链条断裂，可能影响营收预期，进而波及相互采购的公司。

segments.en: So that's why I think earnings reports are so heavily scrutinized, especially the CapEx number that comes out every quarter.
segments.zh: 所以财报备受关注，尤其是每季度的资本开支。

segments.en: So far, it's not the case has been the case where that's, you know, dented investor enthusiasm about it.
segments.zh: 目前这并未削弱市场热情。

segments.en: But I would say also, if you look at mega cap leadership this year, it has definitely broken down. They are not the market leaders.
segments.zh: 但今年超大盘股的领导地位已经瓦解，它们不再是市场领头羊。

segments.en: They might be up and positive year to date, but they are not the market leaders.
segments.zh: 它们年内可能上涨，但已不是市场领导者。

segments.en: So we're already starting to see that sort of reacted in the market, more rotational, not necessarily correctional.
segments.zh: 市场已出现轮动，而非调整。
